# Scribbr

> Scribbr is a comprehensive academic writing platform offering AI-powered proofreading, citation generation, plagiarism detection, and writing guidance to help students graduate.

Scribbr provides free and premium tools for academic writing support, including an AI Proofreader trained by expert editors, grammar checking, and reference generators supporting multiple citation styles (APA, Harvard, MLA, Chicago). The platform serves UK and international students with resources spanning writing techniques, research methods, and citation formatting.

## Core Writing Tools

- [AI Proofreader](https://www.scribbr.co.uk/ai-proofreader): AI Proofreader product trained by top editors for advanced academic language correction
- [Grammar Checker](https://www.scribbr.co.uk/grammar-checker): Free AI grammar checker for correcting grammar, spelling, punctuation and word choice
- [Text Summariser](https://www.scribbr.co.uk/text-summariser): AI-powered text summarizer for quickly condensing documents and academic papers

## Citation & Reference Tools

- [Referencing Generator](https://www.scribbr.co.uk/referencing/generator): Free referencing generator supporting Harvard, APA, MLA, and Chicago citation styles
- [APA Reference Generator](https://www.scribbr.co.uk/referencing/generator/apa): Free APA citation generator verified by experts for quick reference formatting
- [Harvard Referencing Generator](https://www.scribbr.co.uk/referencing/generator/harvard): Free Harvard reference generator following Cite Them Right guidelines for UK universities
